book.name: Maatoos
book.title: Maatoosin Thaapoono Imbaa Wontea Yesus Kiristoossa Dhacchintan Goynam Giyayno Barjosa Upsino

content: Yiithadhon Bheetansa Kamsino
Agaa rooroaka Yesus oonira utayse bazinsa aponte ki dooqade.
Kikal bukoono eeno konin thoothonna, kidi bazindara sagadhen gonngalante ardayse ki dooqade; eeno wulaar bazinsa aponte ko woyade.
Thoothi yeram kamsika kena giyan ki yedade: ‘‘Marrato! Eedi kalaa haaminte yisa bheeta yiithota ki utade.
Bheetan kinin yiithenka, bheetano waani goyn aponte ko wavaysaka aptinaar nivayse kamate ke itsade.
Waani bheetano thoothin peenin qolmon haachandar ko wavade; pee thoothinin qolmonna saanawa ko baqalade.
Haynin utayse oydhenkaar, ko halatade; caaciyn yittsaamonna ko wocchade.
Waani bheetano ukumbhansa shaarinte ko wavade; ukumbhanoar gebhayse baqalon bheetanam ko ishkade.
Waani bheetano peen payyandar ko wavade, aapiar ushidine; waa kisa aapi eedi dong kaysa, waa kisa pir aapi eedi makkam kaysa, waa kisa pir aapi eedi kalaa kaysa apo tabhi ke ushade.
Keeda qansen qaamiysa dahaa ki qanse’’ kena ki hamade.
Yesus Kamsika Kinin Giyonsa Goyno
Ogosa budonte Yesussa paanan yivayna eena kikal theedayse, ‘‘Eenna kamsinka harrnaa giye?’’ hamayse kiam ke oysade.
Kidi kena maasayse ‘‘Yenante Barjo bitamonsa aachin dhalqinam yenin dhesoadettsi imbhidine. Een waanina ko hanna imbhadehe.
Harrna hambhidianna, yisa dahaana kisa dohondar kina imbha ko imbhe; kinaar mirga ko mirge. Yisa qolmakalanka kisa dohonam kikala tiidha ko tiidhe.
Ogona shedite dahayse shedimina kenin maatonna, qansite dahayse qansimina kenin maatonna, pir kenin bhocchimonna, kena inta kamsika ida giye.

content.text: ‘Eena kina qansa ke qanse, yinin qansenam bhocchehe;
sheda ke shede, yinin shedenam qaabehe.
woylaminka kedi qaabayse idar ke maataysaka

content: hamayse kesa Isiasin ena birayse giyoono ko thoothade.
‘‘Aapin yennonin shedenna, qaamin yennonin qansenna yedi gobshadhaanane.

Inta yena gon ida giye: Thoothina Barjokala qansayse eenna giyayna eenabee tipana eenabe yenin shedenam shedota anngardhidine, ko dahaannaar shedadehe; yenin qansenam qansana anngardhidine, ko dahaannaar qansadehe’’ hamayse kena ki giyade.
Yiithadhon Bheetansa Kamsin Bulino
Pir Yesus kena yin ki giyade: ‘‘Ta yedi bheetan yiitheasa kamsinsa bulinam qansimate.
Barjo bitamonsa upsinam qansayse qaabima easa Seethaan nivayse woylaminte kisa yiithadhon upsinam kida tiye; agaa ea goyn aponte wavaa bheetadettsine.
Peen haachandar yiithadhoono bheetano Barjosa upsinam qansayse saanawa wozanka tiyea eadettsine.
Ea agaa caaci yinin yittsaamonna, kisa woyano likka wodanane; Barjosa upsinna gaale way oytaydha kidar konin yeskenka saanawa kida gare.

Ukumbhansa shaarinte yiithadhoono bheetano Barjosa upsinam qansea eadettsine; yi qansaakaar peen kosa bhocchinbee wodimmakkon anngarmanbeka Barjosa upsino kinin qansoono kisa woylaminte sun ishkimayse aapi ushima koda shidhe.

Peen payyandar wavaa bheetaa Barjosa upsinam qansayse bhocchika tiyea eadettsine. Agaa ea aapi usha ki ushe; kalaa kisa aapi eedi dong kaysa, waa pir aapi eedi makkam kaysa, waa pir aapi eedi kalaa kaysa apo tabhi keda ushe’’ kena ki hamade.
Suwansa Kamsino
Yesus kamsi ab yin ki giyade: ‘‘Barjosa bitamono haamin yinnonte bheetan payyan yiithaa eadettsine.
Een wulin raaton wodanka, kisa banqin ea sootinka nivayse bargan yiithadhonsa iinte suwanam yiithayse ki yivade.
Barganin baqalayse ushenka suwanoar wodan ogoka ko haapadhade.
Waadadhayna eena haamin imbaakal nivayse, ‘Imbo, haaminte hasa hanin yiithoono bheetano payyatayu? Ta suwano hamora ko nivaa?’ kina ke hamade.
Kidiar kena, ‘Ogoam yin hayaa banqin eane’ ki hamade. Kisa waadiman eena kina, ‘Ta hana suwanam yivayse wonin buucoadettsi ya zagaa zago?’ ke hamade.
Kidiar kena yin giyayse ki maasade: ‘Yin hayeebhode! Suwanam yenin buucenka barganam kanka yeda buuce.

Ogona garmate; ushayse konin shikadhen wodanka yekka kinka ko gebhe. Ushayse shikadhen wodanka, koam shikayna eenana, ‘‘Suwanam birayse shikee; nuuntear koam koqota kidar buskayse dhaxee. Barganam kidar buskayse kononte isa kee’’ kena hamayse ida giye’ ki hamade.’’
Saliithan Aapinsa Kamsino
Yesus kamsi ab kena yin ki giyade: ‘‘Barjosa bitamono saliithasa
aapi eedi kalaa yisa haaminte kinin yiithon bheetandettsine.
Bheeta agaa bheetan wulsa iira likkane. Kinin gebhon wodanka haaqana wulsa iira kidi bashine; aptinaar nivayse antindar kisa ooni kenin woysoadettsi haaqa gaari kida maate’’ kena ki hamade.
Dhiilin Taapansa Kamsino

Yesus kamsi ab kena yin ki giyade: ‘‘Barjosa bitamono maa kallo dhiili sharqa makkam tiyate kanka konin taapaa irshodettsine; irshono konin dhiilin taapon taapanam konin oydhoadettsi ko hayade’’ kena ki hamade.
Yesus Kamsinka Kinin Dhettsonsa Goyno
Yesus ogo wulam zarsinna kamsika ki giyade; yinin giyen yerin wulam kamsi qolma kena giyehe.
Ogosa goyno

content.text: peen pijadhorra yedayse aachimon yerin ida giye’’

content: hamayse ena birayse Barjokala qansayse eenna giyea eayn giyondettsi ko thoothade.
Suwan Kamsinsa Bulino
Ogosa budonte Yesus zarsinam garayse kidi ooninte ki ardade. Kisa paanan yivayna eena kikal nivayse, ‘‘Imbo, haaminte dohon suwan kamsinsa bulinam wona giyma’’ ke hamade.
Yesus kena yin giyayse ki maasade: ‘‘Bheetan payyan haaminte yiithaa inta Eedi Naasine.
Hammo peeno konone; payyana bheetana Barjo naanane. Suwana Seethaan naanane;
suwanam yiithaa banqin ea Seethaanne. Haaminsa shikan wodano peen kosa macchin wodanone; shikayna Barjosa gaananane.
Ogonante suwanam shikate kidar dhaxayse nuunte koqadheadettsi, peensa macchin wodanka yin koda maate.
Ogo wodanka inta Eedi Naas gaanana innaam nittsayda nittse; kediar seesonsa iinte eenaam arsayna eenabee siyon waadadhayna eena wulbeam isa bitamora edate bulayse
dikimon nuunsa iinte keam keda dhabe. Ogotear eepibee atsi qiicabe koda maate.
Ogo wodanka tipana eena Imbaa kenteasa bitamonte haydettsi keda shaake. Qansen qaamiysa dahaa ki qanse’’ ki hamade.
Aachadhon Koymonsa Kamsino

Guttsayse Yesus yin ki giyade: ‘‘Barjosa bitamono haaminsa iir aachadhaa koymoadettsine. Eedi kalaa ogo koymon haapayse maasate pir ki aachade. Kattsi kinin wozadhonna yivayse yisa dohon wulam shanshayse ogo haaminam ki shanade.
Bazaysa Dethaa Inquasa Kamsino
‘‘Pir Barjosa bitamono bazira kambhea inqua bazaysa dethaam shanota zagea naggadeadettsine.
Agaa naggadea bazaysa kattsi dethaa inquam yinin haaponsa budonte, yivayse yisa dohon wulam shanshayse yera agaam ki shanade’’ kena ki hamade.
Kaaran Yedadhen Zaaninsa Kamsino
Guttsayse Yesus yin ki giyade: ‘‘Barjosa bitamono bazinsa iinte dhabadhaysaka kaaran ayni waana waana hamonam yeden zaanindettsine.
Zaaninte kaaranin thoothonsa budonte eena bazinsa gasandar gochate keda bule. Dooqayse konin yedonsa iira payyan payyanam edate kenin bevente keda wode; siyon siyonam os keda dhabe.
Peensa macchin wodanka yin koda maate; Barjosa gaanana nivayse siyana eenaam tipana eenakalanka eda ke ede.
Dikimon nuunsa iinte keam keda dhabe. Ogotear eepibee atsi qiicabe koda maate.
‘‘Ogo wulam yedi bhocchidu?’’ kena ki hamade. Kediar, ‘‘Wodi bhocchidine’’ ke hamade.
Kidiar, ‘‘Ogo yin ko hanna, Barjosa bitamon goynsa payya hayayse dhesea Musesa yigginam dhettsea yinnon koymora haalinbee gecchonbeam bulea imbaadettsine’’ kena ki hamade.
Naazret Katamante Yesusin Bagadhoono
Yesus igina kamsinaam giyate kinin macchonsa budonte, raqin ogora ki yivade.

Ogora yinin gebhon peente Naazret katamandar nivayse kesa bukin raqinte Barjosa upsinam dhettsite ki dahade. Eeno kisa dhalqinka targadhayse, yin giyte ko dahade: ‘‘Kaa ea pakalmakkon kobee ko eenaam tarshen yerinbeam hamora ki bavaa?
Kaa haaqan qarsea ea naasitayu? Indaano kisa Mayriyam hambhaynotayu? Kisa indanaana Yayqoobbee, Yoseepbee,
Simoonbee, Yiwdabetayu?
Kisa indanaana anzana wul wombete dahaanatayu? Ta ea kaa ko wulam hamora ki haapaa?’’ hamayse
kisa dhalqinam bagayse tiyma ke garade. Yesus ‘‘Barjokala qansayse eenna giyea kinin gobshadhimino peen een yinnonbee oonin eena yinnabekal bishne’’ kena ki hamade.
Kinin giyenam gonne hamayse kenin tiyaamonna, Yesus raqin ogote thoothi tarshea yer hayadehe.

footnotes.text: ‘‘Bargabee suwabe’’ hambhayno gaalin aponka gazgobee gazgodettsi maataa shudhi abbene. Igina yerram kamsina ko tiidhade.

‘‘Saliitha’’ hambhayno gaalin aponka ‘‘senafic’’ hamayse thaapadhoonone. Aapino kosa kattsi likkinca dahayse, duuqadhanna kattsi haaqa gaaridettsi konin gebhenna, ogono hattono Banen peente konin qolmonna, kamsina saliitha aapiam ko tiidhade.
Raqa kaate ‘‘Yoseep’’ hamea naabea Marq 6:3dar ‘‘Yoosa’’ koda hame.
